Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can choose to not digivolve. In such cases, you shuffle all of the searched cards and return them to the security stack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to search my security stack but choose to not digivolve?

Card Q&A.a: You perform the digivolution bonus draw when a card is placed on top of the Digimon to digivolve. A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules. After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.
Card Q&A.q: When exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw when a digivolution would occur by this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect?

I used this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to digivolve this card. If I then use the part of the effect after "then" to place a card from the hand into the security stack, can I activate this card's inherited effect?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] Search your security stack. This Digimon may digivolve into a yellow Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait among them without paying the cost. Then, shuffle your security stack. If this effect digivolved, you may place 1 yellow card with the [Vaccine] trait from your hand as the bottom security card.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When your security stack is added to, gain 1 memory.
